title: Evaluation
description: 200 response of POST /v1/evaluate. The phone stores it in its Evaluation record (TRD 3.3) and copies verdict.event_type, verdict.description and s2 into the Moment.

keep.description: Server decision: (save_decision = save and s2 >= SAVE_THRESHOLD) or s2 >= SAVE_ANYWAY_THRESHOLD. Always true for purpose = describe. false releases the phone's speculative hold.

s2.description: Final score (TRD §8), computed on the server from the verdict and context.local.novelty.

tier.description: Which model produced the verdict: 2a fast, 2b strong.

latency_ms.description: Server time for the whole request.

verdict.description: Model output (TRD §8), with scores clamped and text truncated by the server.

best_frame_index.description: 0-based index into the frames sent; always below the number of frames.

window_hint_s.description: Suggested seconds to keep before and after frame t. The phone may extend its hold toward this, up to its own caps.

description.description: At most 20 words, only what is visible.

reason.description: At most 25 words. For logs and tuning.
